vocabulary.meaning_en: used to introduce the first point in a list
vocabulary.example: Firstly, I have the right skills for this job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: used to introduce the second point
vocabulary.example: Secondly, I enjoy working with people.

vocabulary.meaning_en: most importantly; used for the strongest point
vocabulary.meaning_ar: وفوق كل شيء / والأهم من ذلك
vocabulary.example: Above all, I want to learn and grow with your company.

vocabulary.meaning_en: why something happens or why you do something
vocabulary.example: The main reason I applied is the training.

vocabulary.meaning_en: organise your ideas in a clear order
vocabulary.note_ar: وتأتي اسمًا أيضًا: a clear structure
vocabulary.note_en: Also a noun: a clear structure.
vocabulary.example: Try to structure your answers in an interview.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a perfect fit between two things
vocabulary.example: This job is an ideal match for my skills.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very keen and wanting very much to succeed
vocabulary.example: I am really motivated to do this job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: happy and ready to do something
vocabulary.example: I am willing to work very hard.

vocabulary.meaning_en: showing a lot of interest and energy
have a friendly relationship with someone
vocabulary.example: I get on with people easily.
It is one of the fastest-growing companies in the city.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a business that makes or sells things
vocabulary.example: Which company do you work for?

vocabulary.meaning_en: belong to a group or a project
vocabulary.example: I want to be part of your team.
He works in the technology sector.

vocabulary.meaning_en: ask someone questions to decide if they get a job
vocabulary.example: They interviewed six people for the job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: with less colour in the face than usual, often because you feel ill or afraid
vocabulary.example: You look pale. Sit down, please.

vocabulary.meaning_en: said after a stop, to go back to what you were talking about
vocabulary.example: Sorry about that. Now, where were we?

fine_lines.title: firstly / secondly vs first / second
fine_lines.explanation_ar: يمكن قول Firstly أو First في بداية الجملة لترتيب الأفكار، وكلاهما صحيح. Firstly أكثر رسمية قليلًا. وننهي القائمة بـ Above all أو Finally.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both "Firstly" and "First" can start a list of points. "Firstly" is a little more formal. End with "Above all" or "Finally".

examples.sentence: Firstly, I have five years of experience.
First, let me tell you about my studies.

fine_lines.title: motivated vs willing
fine_lines.explanation_ar: motivated: لديك رغبة قوية وحماس للنجاح. willing: مستعدّ أن تفعل شيئًا إن طُلب منك. بعد willing نستخدم to + فعل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Motivated = you really want to succeed. Willing = you are ready to do something if needed. Use "willing to + verb".

examples.sentence: She is very motivated to learn English.
I am willing to travel for work.

expressions.phrase: Firstly, this job is an ideal match for my skills and experience.
expressions.meaning_ar: أولًا، هذه الوظيفة تتطابق تمامًا مع مهاراتي وخبرتي.
expressions.meaning_en: Your first reason: the job fits you well.
expressions.example: Firstly, this job is an ideal match for my skills and experience in sales.
Secondly, I know your company is growing fast.

expressions.phrase: Above all, the reason I want this job is...
expressions.meaning_ar: وفوق كل شيء، السبب الذي يجعلني أريد هذه الوظيفة هو...
expressions.example: Above all, the reason I want this job is that I love helping customers.

expressions.phrase: I am willing to work very hard.
expressions.meaning_en: You are ready to put in a lot of effort.
expressions.example: If I get the job, I am willing to work very hard.

expressions.meaning_en: A question to check what someone means.
expressions.example: So you're very motivated, then? That's great.

expressions.phrase: I get on with people easily.
expressions.meaning_en: You make friends and work well with others.
expressions.example: I get on with people easily, so I enjoy team work.

grammar.title: Sequencing words: firstly, secondly, above all
grammar.explanation_ar: لتنظيم إجابتك في المقابلة رتّب أسبابك: ابدأ بـ Firstly ثم Secondly، واختم بأقوى سبب مع Above all. نضع فاصلة بعد كل كلمة منها في بداية الجملة.
grammar.explanation_en: To organise your answer, list your reasons: Firstly..., Secondly..., and finish with your best reason: Above all... Put a comma after each word at the start of the sentence.
examples: Firstly, I have the right experience.
Secondly, I enjoy working in a team.
Above all, I really believe in your products.

grammar.title: Saying it another way (paraphrasing)
grammar.explanation_ar: إذا نسيت كلمة فلا تتوقف؛ اشرح المعنى بكلمات أبسط. مثلًا بدل motivated يمكن أن تقول: I really want this job and I am willing to work hard.
grammar.explanation_en: If you forget a word, don't stop. Explain the idea in simpler words. Instead of "motivated" you can say: I really want this job and I am willing to work hard.
examples: I can't remember the word, but it's a person who manages money.
I really, really want this job (= I am motivated).
It's a thing you use to save files (= a USB stick).

questions.question: Which word introduces your strongest, final reason?
questions.explanation_ar: Above all تأتي مع السبب الأهم والأخير.
questions.explanation_en: "Above all" introduces the most important reason.

questions.question: ___, this job is an ideal match for my skills.
questions.explanation_en: Start a list of reasons with "Firstly".

questions.question: What does "motivated" mean?
choices: very keen and wanting to succeed
questions.explanation_ar: motivated تعني متحمّس ولديه دافع للنجاح.
questions.explanation_en: It means keen and wanting very much to succeed.

questions.question: "I get on with people easily" means...
choices: I get on the bus with people
I have good relationships with people
questions.explanation_ar: get on with تعني يتوافق مع الآخرين.
questions.explanation_en: "Get on with" means have a good relationship.

questions.question: If you forget a word in an interview, you should...
choices: explain the idea in other words
questions.explanation_ar: الحل هو شرح المعنى بكلمات أخرى.
questions.explanation_en: Say the idea in another way.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: Secondly I know, your company grow fast.
Secondly, I know your company is growing fast.
Second the, I know your company growing fast.
Secondly, I knowing your company is growing fast.
questions.explanation_ar: الجملة الصحيحة: فاصلة بعد Secondly واستخدام is growing.
questions.explanation_en: Comma after "Secondly" and the correct verb "is growing".

questions.question: "Where were we?" is used to...
choices: go back to the topic after a stop
questions.explanation_ar: تُقال للعودة إلى الموضوع بعد مقاطعة.
questions.explanation_en: You say it to return to the topic after an interruption.

questions.question: Which word means "ready to do something if it is needed"?
questions.explanation_ar: willing تعني مستعدّ لفعل شيء إذا لزم الأمر، أما motivated فتعني لديه دافع قوي للنجاح.
questions.explanation_en: "Willing" means ready to do something if needed; "motivated" means wanting very much to succeed.
